definitions.explanation: The sweet taste quality, one of the five basic tastes.
Sweet foods or confections. Also read as かんみ in this meaning.

examples.japanese: この{桃|もも}は{甘味|あまみ}が{十分|じゅうぶん}ある。
examples.english: This peach has plenty of sweetness.

examples.japanese: {砂糖|さとう}を{入|い}れて{甘味|あまみ}を{足|た}した。
examples.english: I added sugar to increase the sweetness.

examples.japanese: {食後|しょくご}に{甘味|あまみ}を{楽|たの}しむ。

notes:
FORMATION:
{甘|あま}い (sweet) + {味|み} (taste)

PRONUNCIATION:
・あまみ - primarily for 'sweetness (taste)'
・かんみ - also used, especially for 'sweets'

COLLOCATIONS:
・{甘味|あまみ}が{強|つよ}い - strongly sweet
・{甘味|あまみ}を{加|くわ}える - to add sweetness
・{甘味|あまみ}{処|どころ} - sweet shop (read かんみどころ)
・{甘味|あまみ}{料|りょう} - sweetening (read かんみりょう)

RELATED WORDS:
・{酸味|さんみ} - sourness
・{旨味|うまみ} - umami
・{甘|あま}い - sweet (adjective)
